title.zh: 将塔克洛班市 Basper 描笼涯塔克洛班市国立中学－Basper 附属校分离并改设为名为塔克洛班国立农业学校的独立国立农业学校并拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Tacloban City National High School-basper Annex in Barangay Basper, Tacloban City, From the Tacloban City National High School in Barangay Bagacay, Also in Tacloban City, and Converting It Into a Separate and Independent National Agricultural School to Be Known as the Tacloban National Agricultural School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

text.en: The Tacloban City National High School-Basper Annex in Barangay Basper, Tacloban City, is hereby separated from the Tacloban City National High School in Barangay Bagacay, also in Tacloban City, and converted into a separate and independent national agricultural school to be known as the Tacloban National Agricultural School.
The school shall offer agriculture secondary education proper to carry out its objectives.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.

The title to and ownership of the land of the present Tacloban City National High School-Basper Annex located at Barangay Basper, Tacloban City, together with the two (2) school buildings thereon, shall automatically be transferred to the Tacloban National Agricultural School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
